lines.zh: 我贴着地面滑，身子一折一折。
lines.en: I glide along the ground, folding and unfolding.
The grass flattens into a path behind me.

lines.zh: 我不走直线，我顺着地走。
lines.en: I don't go straight; I follow the ground.

lines.zh: 我从石头缝下整个穿过
lines.en: I pass clean under the gap beneath the rock.
My scales rasp the soil.
I ease my head into the grass.

lines.zh: 我绕着一个矮丘走了半圈。
lines.en: I move half around a low mound.

lines.zh: 身体太长，我得缓缓收尾。
lines.en: I'm long, so my tail comes round slowly.
I move steadily over the plains.
I climb a little and coil.

lines.zh: 我顺着树干往上，一伸一缩。
lines.en: I go up the trunk, stretch and pull.

lines.zh: 我又回到白天晒过的那块石头。
lines.en: I'm back at the stone I sunned on.

lines.zh: 我盘成一团，头搁在正中。
lines.en: I'm coiled with my head in the middle.

lines.zh: 暖意渗进我盘着的每一圈
lines.en: Warmth soaks into every coil of mine.
I flick my tongue and taste the air.
I slow even my breathing right down.

lines.zh: 我的花纹在光下很好看。
lines.en: My pattern shows nicely in the light.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把身体绕紧一点。
lines.en: I draw my coils a little tighter.
The grass moves in the wind; I don't.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛上有一层透明的膜。
lines.en: A clear scale covers each of my eyes.

lines.zh: 我听见地底下有东西在挖。
lines.en: I hear something digging underground.

lines.zh: 我把下巴搁在自己的身子上。
lines.en: I rest my chin on my own coils.
I open my mouth and shift my jaw.
This stone has gotten very hot.
I'm waiting for something small to pass.
I flick my tongue again.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴尖轻轻蹭着草。
lines.en: My tail tip brushes the grass.

lines.zh: 我很慢，可我一直在注意。
lines.en: I'm slow, but I'm always paying attention.

lines.zh: 影子挪了一点，我跟着挪。
lines.en: The shade shifted and I shifted with it.
I pull myself into a rounder ball.
You're standing there; I lift my head.

lines.zh: 我把头侧过来，一只眼看你。
lines.en: I turn my head and watch with one eye.
You're warm; I can feel it.
I hold still and study you first.

lines.zh: 我的舌头伸出来又收回去。
lines.en: My tongue comes out and goes back.

lines.zh: 你站着，像一棵会走的树
lines.en: You stand like a tree that walks.
I edge toward the stone.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我的身上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on me.
I don't like being picked up.
Reach for me and I'll ball up.
I flick my tongue out to taste again.
Watching each other like this is fine.
I've balled up instantly.
I've tucked my head innermost.
That landed on my coils.

lines.zh: 我盘紧的圈被撞散了一点
lines.en: The blow loosens one of my coils.
I don't loosen at all.
It's a long while before I poke my head out.
Two of my scales have come off.

lines.zh: 土里的凉气钻进我的腹鳞
lines.en: The chill of the soil seeps into my belly scales.
I've no throat to cry with.
I've pulled in tighter.
I smell a mouse.
I stretch my head out and taste the air.
It's still warm.
I try my mouth open.
Let me get my coils set first.
Not much of a meal.

lines.zh: 别举着，放下来我慢慢吞
lines.en: Stop holding it up. Set it down and I'll take my time.
I coil half around it.
I take it and swallow slowly.
This will last me a long while.
You touch me and I pull in at once.
I've rolled into a tight ball.
My head is tucked innermost.
You nudged me.
I still don't move.

lines.zh: 过了很久我才松开一点。
lines.en: It's a long while before I loosen.
That rolled me half a turn.
I slowly poke my head out.
You're still here, so I tuck back in.
I've gone a bit cold.

lines.zh: 另一条花纹的从我身边过。
lines.en: Another of my pattern glides past.

lines.zh: 我用头碰了碰它的侧腹。
lines.en: I touch its flank with my head.

lines.zh: 我们并排盘着，鳞片挨着。
lines.en: We coil side by side, scales touching.
It flicks its tongue; so do I.
This stone is big enough for two.
We twine together slowly.
In the sun, neither of us moves.
Its pattern is darker than mine.
After a long while, it moves first.
We part and go our own ways.
I catch the mouse in one strike.
Too big; I can't get it down.
I test its width first.
I got the whole thing down.
Something inside it is pressing against me.
No smell of meat, so I circle it.

lines.zh: 我把它从喉咙里推回嘴里
lines.en: I push it back up out of my throat.
I circle it and look.
I nudge it with my head.
I push it over to the stone.
There's a stir in the grass.
I lower my head to the ground.
I hang my head right above it.
The grass keeps me hidden.
I gather my coils behind me.
I've got it in my eye.

lines.zh: 我量了量它的宽度，能吞
lines.en: I measure its width. It will fit.
That size will go down.
I wait for one more step from it.

lines.zh: 我的前半身离地，往前探
lines.en: My front half lifts off the ground and reaches forward.

lines.zh: 我的肚子压着土，一寸寸跟
lines.en: My belly presses the dirt as I follow inch by inch.
It goes left; I go around ahead of it.

lines.zh: 我有的是时间等它犯错
lines.en: I have all the time in the world to wait for a mistake.
It takes a step, I take half an inch.
I lie flat on the soil.
It stops, so I go completely still.
My neck is already taut.
It has turned the back of its neck to me.
This angle is the best one.

lines.zh: 我把嘴张到能吞下的宽度
lines.en: I open my mouth to the width it takes.
I strike and hold.

lines.zh: 我的身体一圈圈缠上去。
lines.en: My coils wrap around it.
Each coil tightens a little.
It can't struggle.
I start working it down.
Halfway down, I pause.
I work it whole down my throat.
I work it down slowly.
I coil up and stay still.
That will keep me fed a long while.

lines.zh: 我先探出鼻子，才抬起身子
lines.en: I poke out my snout before raising my body.

lines.zh: 第一眼是很大一片平原。
lines.en: The first sight is a wide plain.

lines.zh: 我盘了一下，找了个方向。
lines.en: I coil, then pick a direction.

lines.zh: 太阳正好，我晒了一会儿。
lines.en: The sun's right, so I bask a while.

lines.zh: 我的花纹还是最普通的那种。
lines.en: My pattern is the plainest kind.

lines.zh: 我把一圈圈摊开，占了半片地
lines.en: I unroll coil by coil and take half the ground.
The soil is a little cold.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有东西在跑。
lines.en: I hear something running far off.

lines.zh: 我的舌头沾了土，我收回去了。
lines.en: My tongue got dirt on it; I pull it in.
I head for a stone.
I test the stone's warmth.
I drape myself over it.
The heat makes me come uncoiled at once.

lines.zh: 我从石头上摔下来，摊开了。
lines.en: I fall off the stone and spill open.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的肺，我挣不脱。
lines.en: Water fills my lungs and I can't get free.
The blast throws my whole length up.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我的身侧，我缠紧了
lines.en: An arrow sinks into my side and I coil tighter.
My coils tighten without my will.
I'm too hungry to hold my coil.

lines.zh: 雷劈在近处，我整条绷直
lines.en: Lightning strikes nearby and my whole body goes rigid.

lines.zh: 下面没有石头了，我往下坠。
lines.en: No stone below; I fall.
